authority.freeze_order_law: this law freezes BEFORE any candidate PnL exists; A7 may adjust the numeric floors pre-outcome only, with rationale recorded in this file's floor_adjustments block

candidate_set_law.asset_law: BTC-only-short specialists are ineligible on SPY (filtered before any comparison, info code ASSET_INELIGIBLE); every regime retains >=1 asset-eligible specialist by library construction
candidate_set_law.library_bound: at most 2 specialists per regime, from freezes/specialist_library_freeze.json

specialist_classes.BTC_ONLY_SHORT: specialists whose target direction can be short and whose library eligibility flag is BTC-only

candidate_set_law.unk_law: TRANSITION_UNKNOWN routes FLAT always (UNK_FLAT fixed); never selectable, reason FIXED_FLAT_UNK

counts_definitions.eligible_decision_for_regime: an exec-bar decision whose persisted regime is R at decision close AND whose regime-bar offset inside its R-episode is >= transition_buffer_k + 1 = 2 (the first buffer bar of an episode cannot admit an entry); specialist-independent by construction
counts_definitions.episode: maximal contiguous run of one persisted label in the cell's regime-bar stream (rsmv1.regime_timeline.episodes); episode boundaries include stream edges
counts_definitions.inner_pooling: episodes and eligible decisions are POOLED over the inner folds of fold k; outer folds are never pooled with inner folds; cells are never pooled with each other

decision_procedure.law: ordered rules, FIRST MATCH WINS; every (cell, regime R, outer fold k) terminates in exactly one outcome {FLAT, specialist_id} with exactly one reason_code; the procedure is total and deterministic — no unspecified tie exists

pair_resolution.comparison_metric: inner pooled NET PnL at BASE tier (1.0x) costs, computed ONLY inside R-windows of inner folds (each specialist runs its own frozen spec with fold force-flat, next-executable-open fills, fraction 1.0)
pair_resolution.delta_law: delta = net_higher - net_lower over the two candidates

exact_numeric_tie.recording: every applied tie-break is recorded with the delta and the class of both candidates
resolution: if exactly one candidate is BTC_ONLY_SHORT: select it, reason TIE_BREAK_BTC_SHORT
else (both LONG_CAPABLE, both BTC_ONLY_SHORT, or one FLAT-class): FLAT, reason TIE_BREAK_FLAT

stability.comparative_folds_S: inner folds where BOTH candidates have >= 1 episode in R
stability.required_wins: ceil(2 * |S| / 3) wins in S for the pooled winner (|S|=1 -> 1, |S|=2 -> 2, |S|=3 -> 2); this equals 'higher on EVERY comparative inner fold when <= 2 inner folds, else >= 2/3'

rules.label: NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME
rules.predicate: outer sample floors fail for (cell, R, k)

rules.outcome: CONTINUE with eligible set E (|E| in {1,2})
rules.predicate: filter library specialists for R by asset eligibility
inner floors fail for R pooled over folds 1..k-1

floor_adjustments.who: A7 only, BEFORE any outcome, with rationale recorded here

inner_floors.applies: per regime R, pooled over folds 1..k-1; below EITHER floor => FLAT for R in fold k, reason INNER_FLOOR_FAIL

outer_sample_floors.applies: per cell x regime x outer fold; below ANY floor => that regime x cell x fold routes FLAT and is labeled NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME (the router still runs; the thin regime contributes no specialist risk)
outer_sample_floors.label_persistence: NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME cells/regs are reported in every artifact and excluded from the candidate gate denominator (evaluation freeze); the label is never silently dropped

input_pins.cells_law: cells BTC_H1, BTC_H4, SPY_D1 are NEVER pooled to fake sample size; BTC_H1 and BTC_H4 are independent cells and H1-vs-H4 selection by PnL is forbidden

fold_contract.use: outer fold boundaries k=1..4 per cell (V2 boundaries, byte-authoritative — never restated here); warmup 192

specialist_library.use: the selectable specialist set per regime (max 2); entry/exit parameters; asset eligibility flags

nested_walk_forward_law.fold_1_default: k=1 has an empty inner set => FLAT for every selectable regime, reason code FOLD1_NO_INNER (the law's own insufficient-evidence default)
nested_walk_forward_law.outer_scored_once: the outer fold k is scored EXACTLY ONCE with the selections frozen from inner data; no retuning, re-selection, or re-scoring of an outer fold is permitted for any reason; violating this voids the cell (TECHABORT ladder)
nested_walk_forward_law.selection_grain: selection is per cell x per regime x per outer fold

no_peeking_law: inner pooled NET is computed ONLY from inner folds; outer fold prices/decisions may not enter any selection statistic; a leak test (selection invariance under outer-fold data mutation) is mandatory in tests

thin_regime_law.anti_fraud_law: a thin regime must never be merged, window-shifted, or cell-pooled to pass a floor
thin_regime_law.effect: FLAT routing for that regime in that fold; selection output still recorded with reason OUTER_FLOOR_THIN; the label propagates to the evaluation freeze's denominator and to any BLOCKED_THIN_REGIME_SAMPLE verdict
thin_regime_law.label: NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME

totality_law: the reason_code_vocabulary is EXHAUSTIVE: every terminal state of the decision procedure carries exactly one of these codes; a state outside the vocabulary is an implementation bug (hard failure), not a judgment call
